# Frontend Core Instructions

- Follow the generalized JavaScript and TypeScript guidance from the global
  instructions.
- Use the repository's existing JavaScript/JSX setup; do not migrate files to
  TypeScript without an explicit request.
- Use named exports for reusable modules and keep imports relative to the current
  project conventions.
- Keep API response handling explicit and preserve meaningful errors.
- Prefer existing dependencies and browser APIs; do not invent new project
  conventions or dependencies.
